reason: Article 19(4) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 requires financial entities to submit an initial notification, an intermediate report, and a final report to the competent authority. The evidence confirms this by referencing these three reports in multiple provisions of the RTS (Regulatory Technical Standards) 2025/301 and 2025/302.
